'''Mulvek Gar''' was a sergeant in the [[Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations/Legends|Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations]] stationed on [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]]. He was too old for field duty, but had served previously with [[Jared Brojtal]] and was like an uncle to his son. When the boy was killed during the [[Bombing of Syndaar Military Prep School]], he vowed to assist Jared in any way possible to locate [[Ort Hoogra-D'En]], the terrorist responsible.

Mulvek kept an eye on a group of heroes who accepted the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Ort and fed the leads they discovered back to Jared.
